name: Ancillary Purchase 4
definition: Contains additional charges related to or during transit (e.g., baggage fee, in-flight purchase). These are separate from the original ticket purchase.

DocumentNumber.name: Document Number
DocumentNumber.definition: Contains the form number assigned by the carrier for the transaction.

RelatedDocumentNumber.name: Related Document Number
RelatedDocumentNumber.definition: Document number of related transport details.

ServiceCategoryCode.name: Service Category Code
ServiceCategoryCode.definition: Contains an ancillary category code for the primary type of service that has been provided.

ServiceSubCategoryCode.name: Service Sub Category Code
ServiceSubCategoryCode.definition: Contains ancillary service sub category code.

ServiceProviderServiceType.name: Service Provider Service Type
ServiceProviderServiceType.definition: Proprietary service type code assigned by the service provider.

CreditReasonCode.name: Credit Reason Code
CreditReasonCode.definition: Indicates reason for the credit to the cardholder.  Includes: ancillary purchase cancelled, passenger transport ticket and related ancillary purchase cancelled, etc.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

Fee.name: Fee
Fee.definition: Subfield contains the ancillary fee amount.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
